text.p: Cleanup continues along the Red River in the upper Plains of the USA and in southern Manitoba, Canada, near Winnepeg.

Tropical cyclone 01b continues to strengthen as it heads towards the Bangladesh coast. Winds of 115-125 mph are expected at the time of landfall. Landfall should occur during the next 6-12 hours. A strong coastal storm surge should lead to beach errosion and damage. Heavy rains, flooding and strong winds should cause considerable damage as the system moves inland. In addition...the system is still a major risk to shipping in the northeast Bay of Bengal until it moves inland.
